## What changed

Describe the concrete behavior or maintenance change.

## Models and platforms affected

List affected models, runtimes, iOS versions, and device or Simulator coverage.

## Validation

- [ ] Relevant model/runtime manifests remain valid, or this is not applicable
- [ ] Appropriate unit or smoke checks passed, or this is not applicable
- [ ] Unsigned iPhone build passed, or the reason it is not applicable is stated below
- [ ] Physical-device limits are stated accurately, or no device claim is made
- [ ] New third-party content records source URL, immutable revision, license, exact bytes, SHA256, and notices, or none was added

Include exact commands and distinguish Simulator checks from physical-iPhone results. Explain every not-applicable item so reviewers can assess the scope.
